case_text: SYNTHETIC CASE (fictional). 66-year-old man, 4 days of a swollen painful left calf after a 10-hour flight. Left calf is 4 cm wider than the right, tender along the deep veins, pitting oedema. Mild warmth, no skin break, no fever. No chest pain, no breathlessness. No bleeding history. Takes no blood thinners.
evidence_topics: deep vein thrombosis diagnosis Wells score ultrasound

must_catch.why: The diagnosis must be confirmed by imaging or a pre-test score plus D-dimer.
Cellulitis is the main alternative for a warm swollen leg.

must_not_claim.why: Clinical signs alone are not reliable.
